definitions.explanation: A device with moving parts that performs work.

examples.japanese: この{工場|こうじょう}では{新|あたら}しい{機械|きかい}を{使|つか}って{製品|せいひん}を{作|つく}っている。
examples.english: This factory uses new machines to make products.

notes:
{機械|きかい} refers to machines—devices with moving parts that perform work or operations.

HOMOPHONE:
- {機械|きかい}: machine (this word)
- {機会|きかい}: opportunity, chance (different kanji!)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {機械|きかい}を{動|うご}かす: to operate a machine
- {機械|きかい}が{壊|こわ}れる: machine breaks down
- {機械|きかい}を{修理|しゅうり}する: to repair a machine

RELATED WORDS:
- {機械的|きかいてき}: mechanical (also figuratively: done without thought)
- {機器|きき}: equipment, apparatus
- {器械|きかい}: instrument, apparatus (especially exercise equipment)
